summary.text: Ashley Aune is a Democratic state representative who has represented Missouri House District 14 since 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She began serving as House Minority Leader in 2025 and owns a creative studio.

paragraphs.text: Ashley Aune earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Kansas in 2007.
Her career experience includes owning Propel Creative Studio.
She has been a member of Moms Demand Action and Northland Progress.
Aune took office on January 6, 2021, succeeding Matt Sain.
She began serving as State House Minority Leader in 2025.
